sentences.text: On the unseen Banking and Travel test sets, Wrenfold achieved macro-F1 scores of 93.1% and 92.4%, respectively, outperforming Fennick-Base (91.6% and 90.9%) by 1.5 percentage points in both domains.

These results demonstrate a consistent advantage for Wrenfold over Fennick-Base on the held-out test data from the two training domains, but they do not provide evidence about generalization to other, unseen domains because no such evaluation was conducted.
No statistical tests were reported, so the observed differences cannot be characterized as statistically significant.
